description: This file defines the EndpointList class responsible for managing a list of endpoints, tracking active and expired entries, and providing methods to retrieve or remove endpoints based on their state.

classes.name: EndpointList
classes.description: Class for managing active and expired endpoints, with methods for retrieving, removing, and cycling through endpoints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EndpointList with a list of endpoints and sets the active list.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Returns an active endpoint, removing expired entries as necessary.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns an active endpoint if available, otherwise returns an expired endpoint.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified endpoint from both active and expired lists.

methods.name: getExpired
methods.description: Returns an expired endpoint if one exists.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Advances the internal pointer of the given array, resetting if at the end.
